## Formula option gates

These examples leave the formula extension disabled. Every formula syntax
remains ordinary Markdown.

```````````````````````````````` example
Inline $x+y$ end.
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..1:17 children=1
└── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:17 children=1
    └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:17 literal="Inline $x+y$ end." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
$$
x+y
$$
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:2 children=1
└── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..3:2 children=5
    ├── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:2 literal="$$" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak id=2:2 scope=1:3..1:3 children=0
    ├── Text id=2:3 scope=2:1..2:3 literal="x+y" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak id=2:4 scope=2:4..2:4 children=0
    └── Text id=2:5 scope=3:1..3:2 literal="$$" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Inline \\(x+y\\) and \(a+b\).
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..1:29 children=1
└── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:29 children=1
    └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:29 literal="Inline \\(x+y\\) and (a+b)." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Display \\[x+y\\] and \[a+b\].
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..1:30 children=1
└── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:30 children=1
    └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:30 literal="Display \\[x+y\\] and [a+b]." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Formula fenced-code blocks remain ordinary code when formulas are disabled.

```````````````````````````````` example
```formula
x+y
```
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:3 children=1
└── CodeBlock id=2:0 scope=1:1..3:3 info="formula" language="formula" literal="x+y\n" fenced=true closed=true children=0
````````````````````````````````
